description:
Return the published calibration for one example model: method, calibration NSE (daily + monthly),
    PBIAS, evals used, and window as {fit, scored}: the years the calibration was fitted to and the
    years its validation was scored on. Validation NSE is included only when the scored years lie
    outside the fitted years. calibration_status is calibrated_and_validated or calibrated_not_validated
    only where the model's page shows its calibration badge (calibration_advertised), and uncalibrated
    otherwise, including when no calibration of the model is published. Where the example model has a
    recorded calibration run, its numbers are returned with either status: they are that run's scores,
    and the model you download may not carry that calibration. Returns an error with
    code=model_not_found if no such model exists at all. site_no is the model's USGS gauge or HUC outlet
    id.
name: get_model_calibration
title: Get model calibration results
